zh.title: 蕭副總統：無人機發展受法規限制 NCC停擺添壓力
zh.summary: 蕭副總統談無人機發展；法規、空域限制；NCC停擺衝擊
body: 副總統蕭美琴接受中央社專訪時表示，台灣發展無人機除了技術問題，也面臨測試空域及法規限制。行政院已盤點18個無人機測試空域，並設法縮短申請程序。
她指出，新機型及通訊技術涉及射頻、頻譜使用，主管機關國家通訊傳播委員會（NCC）的停擺也對產業造成壓力。她希望朝野看到台灣在軍事安全與產業發展上的實際需求，讓相關配套及方案儘快到位。
此外，蕭副總統提及部分遠距型無人機因缺乏足夠空域，「只能飛上去繞圈圈」以測試續航時間及距離，這部分可尋求國際合作，將台灣無人機帶到理念相近國家進行測試。

en.title: Vice President: Drone Development Faces Regulatory Limits, NCC Paralysis Adds Pressure
en.summary: Vice President cites airspace, frequency regulatory hurdles; NCC paralysis pressures drone industry
body: Vice President Bi-khim Hsiao said in an interview with Central News Agency that Taiwan's drone development faces not only technical challenges but also restrictions on testing airspace and regulations. The Executive Yuan has identified 18 drone testing zones and is working to shorten application procedures.

The vice president said new models and communication technologies require approval from the National Communications Commission (NCC), adding that 'the NCC's paralysis is also causing a certain degree of pressure on the industry.' The NCC is responsible for radio frequency and spectrum matters.

Hsiao expressed hope that both political camps will recognize the actual needs in military security and industrial development, and enable related plans to come through soon. For long-range drones lacking sufficient airspace, she noted they can 'only fly around in circles' to test endurance and distance, and international cooperation could allow tests in larger airspace in friendly countries.
